notes.title: Metal AF Update
notes.content:
I thought to revisit this project and give it a quick update. This update, labeled as "Metal AF" update mainly upgrades the game to the latest Unity engine, as well as changes the whole theme of the game to darker, metal'ish style.  You heard it, the music and the overall font have been changed, so if you're having a hard time reading the new metal font, well, that explains why.. 

The overall vehicle handling has been improved, specifically with the "Stang" vehicle, as it had bug with its handling. ​Day & Night cycle is now a thing. Cinematic Temporal Anti-Aliasing has also been added for much nicer visuals.

There is no point in this update really, besides getting rid of 4th Of July theme urom the last year. I just felt like revisiting a couple of my projects, starting with this one to refresh my memory and move onto a next thing.

notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Update 1.25 is now [b]LIVE[/b] and ready for the download. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35217912/71d40da12bd41b185545e86e37cc02e6ea20485b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Update Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pause Menu
[*] Ability to reset destroyed objects
[*] You can now hit drywall with your legs
[*] Expanded environment
[*] Changed BMW's appearance
[*] New Vehicle: Ford Mustang GT (a little buggy atm)
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] Minor code optimization
[/list]

[b][i]I will be releasing patch sometimes this week, which will address currently known issues. Once patch is out of the way, I will start working on the next update, which will include inventory system, energy drink consumption, stamina revamp, etc.[/i][/b]

[b][i]Hope everyone enjoys the update. If you find any issues/bugs, please report them in discussions so I can fix them at my earliest convenience.[/i][/b]
